name: cloudbake
description: Render Blender scenes on cloud GPUs with CloudBake from Claude Code: send a .blend from your project, and the frames come back into it. Converts to .glb, .fbx and .usdz too.

api_key.title: CloudBake API key
api_key.description: Make one at https://cloudbake.ai/app/connections and paste it here (cb_live_…). It is kept in your system's credential store, not in a settings file. Leave it empty to use CLOUDBAKE_API_KEY from your shell instead.
